coins.name: 大炎通宝
coins.verse: 熔铸技兴　炎币一统　曰之通宝　随处可见
coins.enVerse: Art of mintage. Coin of Yan. Name of Tongbao. Seen everywhere.

coins.name: 西廉贞
coins.verse: 西靠穷山　怪石嶙峋　小人得势　祸心包藏
coins.enVerse: Mounts at west. Cragged stones. Villains rise. Ill will hides.

coins.name: 北刺面
coins.verse: 北窗有松　峥峥如怪　其枝冲面　唯有避之
coins.enVerse: Pine at north. A ghastly sight. Needles intrude. One must evade.

coins.name: 南见山
coins.verse: 坐北朝南　开门见山　重峦叠嶂　且挡其势
coins.enVerse: Mounts at south. Looming over. Ranges unfold. Blocking foes.

coins.name: 东缺角
coins.verse: 天圆地方　东缺一角　言不入耳　家宅不宁
coins.enVerse: Square in circle. East is chipped. Reason not heard. Family disturbed.

coins.name: 奇土生金
coins.verse: 奇土覆币　闻有金臭　盈盈聚财　土亦消匿
coins.enVerse: Covered in dirt. A scent of metal. Wealth gathers. Soil scatters.

coins.name: 水生木护
coins.verse: 埋之地下　可见水光　生木护宅　水光渐散
coins.enVerse: Bury underground. See it glows. House protected. See it dims.

coins.name: 金寒水衍
coins.verse: 币掺异金　抚之极寒　凝露其上　盈盈水色
coins.enVerse: Metal mixed. Cold to touch. Slick with dew. Water's shade.

coins.name: 火灼土沃
coins.verse: 灼烫难触　落地即燃　火熄烟灭　土肥草长
coins.enVerse: Sears to touch. Drops to ignite. Dies with smoke. Soil is fed.

coins.name: 投木炎延
coins.verse: 嵌于柴中　无可取下　投之敌营　猛火不灭
coins.enVerse: Wedged in wood. None can remove. Toss at enemies. Fire ensues.

coins.name: 苦寒
coins.verse: 冽彼冬风　冰雪其雱　任力者苦　移城志高
coins.enVerse: Harsh winter. Thick blizzard. Toil of workers. Move thy city.

coins.name: 匪风
coins.verse: 匪风发发　其流荡荡　两江之渔　以待风息
coins.enVerse: Gale's bluster. Blows asunder. Fincatcher waits. For all to cease.

coins.name: 霖雨
coins.verse: 霖雨霏霏　疏渠活水　润叶泽茎　风雨时也
coins.enVerse: Rain falls. Waters surge. Flora moistened. Seasons turn.

coins.name: 霹雳
coins.verse: 惊雷坠地　百工奔忙　引电疏霆　逢凶化吉
coins.enVerse: Thunders clap. Workers hurry. Channeling bolts. Ensuring safety.

coins.name: 旱热
coins.verse: 朝霞暮霞　无水煎茶　牧草盈仓　有备无患
coins.enVerse: Dawn to dusk. No tea is made. Hay fills barn. Prep for peril.

coins.name: 虹霓
coins.verse: 虹首坠江　饮江皋霁　祸不妄至　谋事在人
coins.enVerse: Rainbow dips. Waterside clears. Woe has cause. Man has plans.

coins.name: 雾凇
coins.verse: 冽彼冰花　太平佳兆　其始播谷　风调雨顺
coins.enVerse: Rime blooms. Peace follows. Sow seeds today. Harvest tomorrow.

coins.name: 霜雪
coins.verse: 冰封霜降　驰道难行　川流车乘　让礼三分
coins.enVerse: Frost grows. Slippery roads. Heavy traffic. Yield as needed.

coins.name: 驰道长
coins.verse: 求工求学　驰道疏通　归程无阻　离多返少
coins.enVerse: Toil and learn. Roads run clear. Many can return. Few truly does.

coins.name: 武人之争
coins.verse: 东拳西腿　争胜永日　好事者众　各学几分
coins.enVerse: Strike and kick. Endless fight. Many onlookers. Watch and learn.

coins.name: 百业俱兴
coins.verse: 两江汤汤　孕彼百氏　百业争发　愈渐繁华
coins.enVerse: Rivers run. Folks settle. Vying trades. Come to bustle.

coins.name: 寒窗志
coins.verse: 繁霜覆窗　萧萧其风　灯下苦读　志高凌云
coins.enVerse: Hoar on window. Howl of wind. Study at night. Aiming high.

coins.name: 志欲遂
coins.verse: 老树开花　心顽志坚　耄儒看榜　今年中乎
coins.enVerse: Old tree blooms. "I still last." Aged testee asks. "Did I pass?"

coins.name: 慧避灾
coins.verse: 钦天之眼　目光炯炯　防灾其冗　化繁为简
coins.enVerse: Sharp eye. Intent gaze. Avoid disasters. Find solutions.

coins.name: 战血流
coins.verse: 烽动鼓鸣　千军即发　武极弭乱　亦能致乱
coins.enVerse: Fires & drums. Thousands march. Wars kill chaos. Or instigate it.

coins.name: 遇良弈
coins.verse: 棋逢对手　相与有成　弈枰胜负　谋定看天
coins.enVerse: Meet your match. A worthy rival. Lose or win? Heaven reigns.

coins.name: 隐市忧
coins.verse: 柴米油盐　隐市之逸　喜怒哀乐　亦有纷扰
coins.enVerse: Chores and all. A reclusive joy. Ups and downs. A mundane life.

coins.name: 法与律
coins.verse: 法之为公　情无可恕　律之悦情　翩翾若舞
coins.enVerse: Law serves. Without mercy. Ritual fulfills. With flexibility.

coins.name: 两江春
coins.verse: 散仙妙手　春回两江　青山有碍　心摧不弃
coins.enVerse: Medic's might. Rivers revive. Difficult path. Resilient heart.

coins.name: 凡物变
coins.verse: 凡物之变　日夜不息　泡影无踪　唯付一笑
coins.enVerse: Things change. Ever unresting. Without a trace. Let it pass.

coins.name: 人间长存
coins.verse: 钢铁拟心　岂能久乎　欲存于世　砥砺必行
coins.enVerse: A heart of steel. Hardly can last. To live as man? It must be honed.

coins.name: 神农守
coins.verse: 枯田万亩　静守千年　壤成膏沃　百谷丰登
coins.enVerse: Barren fields. Patient watchers. Soil grows rich. Grains abundant.

coins.name: 梦奇物
coins.verse: 笔自成书　无人茶沸　垂帘拂面　觉来知梦
coins.enVerse: Brush writes. Tea boils. Beads hang still. A dream ends.

coins.name: 一字落
coins.verse: 教而化之　民识愈开　无字无念　了了忘缘
coins.enVerse: Teach them. Enlighten them. Wordless speech. Worriless lives.

coins.name: 待机缘
coins.verse: 好物有价　至情无市　因时施宜　静待佳音
coins.enVerse: Valuable many. Priceless few. Bide your time. Seize the moment.

coins.name: 画人间
coins.verse: 良辰美景　自有去时　未若画中　墨香长留
coins.enVerse: Beautiful scenes. All shall pass. Draw to remember. Inkscent lingers.

coins.name: 恣狂情
coins.verse: 酒至酣处　诗兴亦狂　或邀双月　或闻征鼓
coins.enVerse: Wine goes down. Verses go wild. Invite the moons. Sing to the drum.

coins.name: 挪移
coins.verse: 借土挪移　天师妙法　纵有天险　须臾即至
coins.enVerse: Shift the lands. Tianshi's might. All that block. Gone from sight.

coins.name: 迅步
coins.verse: 轻身迅步　天师妙法　避障离害　日行千里
coins.enVerse: Swift and fast. Tianshi's might. Dodge all harms. Travel non-stop.

coins.name: 生材百相
coins.verse: 可成玩物　可成器具　可成武备　可成栋梁
coins.enVerse: A toy for play. A tool for use. Maybe a weapon. Or pillar too.

coins.name: 重铠
coins.verse: 精铁百炼　披覆周身　兵灾难侵　寸步难移
coins.enVerse: Forged iron. Head to toe. Hard to pierce. Hard to move.

coins.name: 火机
coins.verse: 人有巧械　可撼群兽　以火为引　地动山摇
coins.enVerse: Clever tool. Scatters beasts. Light with flame. Shake the earth.

coins.name: 岁醒天时
coins.verse: 岁识即醒　天地震荡　伥气起兮　难捱此难
coins.enVerse: SUI is stirred. Realm shakes. Geists rampage. Life despairs.

coins.name: 无皎之昧
coins.verse: 有神无形　浊水晦冥　岁识怨怒　乱流相击
coins.enVerse: Formless spirit. Dark, turbid. SUI is wrathful. Currents clash.

coins.name: 贵有衡
coins.verse: 花愿难长　厉愿艰险　唯有衡久　方得始终
coins.enVerse: Flower fades. Risk is peril. Balance lasts. Through it all.

coins.name: 分久必合
coins.verse: 百氏兴乱　神明睥睨　英杰出世　炎祚久续
coins.enVerse: Clans in chaos. Gods look down. Heroes arise. Yan lasts long.

coins.name: 溯外道
coins.verse: 外力易得　欲壑难填　一步登天　终坠深渊
coins.enVerse: Power easily got. Greed is a pit. Ascend fast. Fall in abyss.

coins.name: 溯正道
coins.verse: 克己养心　循序渐进　步步为营　终得完满
coins.enVerse: Discipline self. Step by step. A measured pace. Fortune aligns.

coins.name: 右迁
coins.verse: 心系民生　时和岁丰　为官有治　便得拔擢
coins.enVerse: Care for folks. Peace & plenty. Rule with skill. Rank promoted.

coins.name: 录武官
coins.verse: 笔录百事　心解万难　触类旁通　制币为念
coins.enVerse: Pen records all. Mind solves all. Grasp by analogy. Coin as token.

coins.name: 柳伥作
coins.verse: 妙手巧思　艺高胆大　化蝶塑碑　制币为念
coins.enVerse: Skillful hands. Bold inventor. Hidden ink. Coin as token.

coins.name: 捕风
coins.verse: 天威难测　顺风难求　封之以瓶　伺机而用
coins.enVerse: Heaven's whims. Fair wind rare. Caught in bottle. Bide thy time.

coins.name: 左秉烛
coins.verse: 少年英才　初见锋芒　贵而知事　制币为念
coins.enVerse: Young and gifted. Talent shines. Wise beyond age. Coin as token.

coins.name: 药食
coins.verse: 体虚乏力　进食以补　阴阳可知　六气可定
coins.enVerse: Exhausted & weak. Eat to recover. Find thy balance. Breathe & revive.

coins.name: 烽火台
coins.verse: 昔时传讯　临高积薪　若见烽燧　千里驰援
coins.enVerse: Beacons built. Wood piled high. Beacons lit. Rush to aid.

coins.name: 孤芳自赏
coins.verse: 力震山河　天师妙法　斥凶绝险　以求清净
coins.enVerse: Shakes the land. Tianshi's might. Repel the ill. Seeking peace.

coins.name: 天命难违
coins.verse: 隔空聚物　天师妙法　祸乱自现　无处可逃
coins.enVerse: Matters gather. Tianshi's might. Chaos reveals. No escape.

coins.name: 庆丰收
coins.verse: 农忙事毕　影戏喧喧　祈愿来年　时和岁丰
coins.enVerse: Harvest's done. Shadow plays on. May next year. Be a year fine.

coins.name: 塞上月
coins.verse: 漠上圆月　寒沙白草　将士出塞　铁衣如雪
coins.enVerse: Moon on Dunes. Bleak sands. Armies in sight. Clad in white.

coins.name: 聚力则强
coins.verse: 广厦亭亭　驰道交通　八方施力　大业既成
coins.enVerse: Halls arise. Roads connect. Hands join in. An age dawns.

coins.name: 军屯垦
coins.verse: 执刃之手　挥锄不辍　良田郁郁　谷仓盈盈
coins.enVerse: Armed forces. Tend the soil. Fields abound. Barns are full.

coins.name: 安硕鼷
coins.verse: 戾彼硕鼷　横行纵暴　食以好麦　无食我苗
coins.enVerse: Fierce megamus. Rampages amok. Have fine grains. Leave my buds.

coins.name: 诡意代币
coins.verse: 您有需求　他有答案　若有诚意　交个朋友
coins.enVerse: You want it. He's got it. Be a friend. And so will he.

coins.name: 合乎礼
coins.verse: 喜宴嘉宾　厚礼相赠　还礼与否　忧以忘喜
coins.enVerse: A joyous feast. A lavish gift. Kindness owed. Dims the joy.

coins.name: 茧成绢
coins.verse: 茧能成绢　故得青目　天下熙熙　惟利是营
coins.enVerse: A humble cocoon. Prized for silk. The land bustles. All for profit.

coins.name: 黑子伏
coins.verse: 诸事顺遂　似有天助　一子既落　已在局中
coins.enVerse: Fortunes align. As if blessed. A move is made. No turning back.

coins.name: 平沙之盾
coins.verse: 边城屡覆　寇乱沙碛　终得一城　走沙御敌
coins.enVerse: Borders fell. Raiders swarmed. A city rises. Defense anew.

coins.name: 火上之灶
coins.verse: 矿以为火　城以为灶　化灾为宜　进取奇速
coins.enVerse: Ore as a fire. City as a stove. Calamity to boon. Progress swift.

coins.name: 界园行
coins.verse: 上游岁识　下览亭园　此间之乐　没齿难忘
coins.enVerse: SUI up above. Garden below. A fleeting joy. Lasts eternal.

coins.name: 债难偿
coins.verse: 一时之利　目眩神移　代代清偿　无边无际
coins.enVerse: A moment's gain. Leading astray. Many in debt. A lot to pay.

coins.name: 触锁代币
coins.verse: 诡秘商贾　行销万物　以币为信　抛之即至
coins.enVerse: Strange trader. All-peddler. Try a toss. One shall come.

coins.name: 延识镇木
coins.verse: 园有奇木　可通岁识　塑之为币　抛之即用
coins.enVerse: Garden wood. A hidden key. Cast as a coin. Path unfolds.

coins.name: 争商机
coins.verse: 横财难居　时利难算　血本难回　人心难知
coins.enVerse: Risky gains. Profit unsure. Costs sunk deep. Minds fickle.

coins.name: 诸灾有迹
coins.verse: 天地异动　大灾将至　辨兆以备　绝处逢生
coins.enVerse: Heaven's omens. Doom draws near. Read the signs. Turn the tide.

coins.name: 得见繁花
coins.verse: 衡不现益　祸有行时　若得花迹　福慧将至
coins.enVerse: Bal yields none. Risk breeds woe. If Flower found. Luck draws near.

coins.name: 兴水利
coins.verse: 分洪抗旱　矫患为惠　劳在当下　利在千秋
coins.enVerse: Divert floods. Turn ill to good. Toil for now. Gain for ages.

coins.name: 南武盛景
coins.verse: 落于炎南　山高林险　以技傍身　以力伏患
coins.enVerse: Southern Yan. High wild mounts. Trust your skill. Power quells ill.

coins.name: 百灶盛景
coins.verse: 国都既建　社稷乃成　裁断万策　节制诸司
coins.enVerse: Capital built. Nation formed. Weigh all plans. Rein all bureaus.

coins.name: 龙门盛景
coins.verse: 落于炎西　灯火不熄　惠商聚财　通联大地
coins.enVerse: Western Yan. Lights kept on. Business flows. Trade with all.

coins.name: 勾吴盛景
coins.verse: 落于炎东　烟雨漫江　珍奇难得　巧工难寻
coins.enVerse: Eastern Yan. Mist on river. Rarities scarce. Craftsmen rare.

coins.name: 大荒盛景
coins.verse: 落于炎北　荒僻无际　深耕苦种　乃得丰泽
coins.enVerse: Northern Yan. Desolate wilds. Plow and sow. Bounty gained.

coins.name: 麟天师
coins.verse: 守心明性　天雷昭昭　破邪正律　制币为念
coins.enVerse: True mindfulness. Thunder strikes. Break the evil. Coin as token.

coins.name: 备用梁
coins.verse: 世事繁杂　备梁以御　偶有遗躯　还之必报
coins.enVerse: World's a tangle. Liang backs you. Spare gear kept. Trade for better.

coins.name: 钱盒底板
coins.verse: 旧底有裂　新底已接　严丝合缝　用料敦实
coins.enVerse: Old base cracks. New one fixed. Fits perfectly. Material solid.

coins.name: 锦囊秒购
coins.verse: 易与之便　自在其中　抛之即成　钱货两清
coins.enVerse: Easy to trade. Find joy in it. Toss it out. Deal is done.

coins.name: 见灵光
coins.verse: 思绪滞涩　杂疑难解　火花乍现　茅塞顿开
coins.enVerse: Thoughts stuck. Doubts remain. Spark appears. All is clear.

coins.name: 移山难
coins.verse: 土木学子　念彼高山　移城在即　技犹不及
coins.enVerse: Cities nomadic. Mounts to move. Tianshi's faith. Paves the way.

coins.name: 移山繁
coins.verse: 彼山崔崔　乡心眷眷　移山迢迢　将勤补拙
coins.enVerse: Mountains loom. A long way home. Skill may fail. Wills prevail.

coins.name: 朝闻道
coins.verse: 天师学徒　难得贤才　朝起闻道　惺忪思眠
coins.enVerse: Young and gifted. A rare find. Seeking truth. Many in dreams.

coins.name: 天下先
coins.verse: 一朝出师　自树其帜　心怀天下　少年壮志
coins.enVerse: Duty calls. Dawn breaks free. A fervent vow. For a bright day.

coins.name: 初有文
coins.verse: 炎字为首　千字呼出　同文同心　百氏共荣
coins.enVerse: First word born. Lexicon spake. Language unites. Nation thrives.

coins.name: 载道远
coins.verse: 著文载道　行以文传　彼江杳杳　有光始清
coins.enVerse: Wisdom forged. Carried & spread. Deep the river. There a glimmer.

coins.name: 勤运体
coins.verse: 轻舞缓行　习拳蹬腿　晨园熙攘　日日不倦
coins.enVerse: Learned moves. In each form. Morning drills. Never worn.

coins.name: 修性情
coins.verse: 吹呼吐纳　凝思冥想　静以养性　防患未然
coins.enVerse: Breathe it in. Find thy calm. Renews the mind. Keep peril away.

coins.name: 心无患
coins.verse: 澹然忘忧　琐事无争　心闲自乐　陶然成趣
coins.enVerse: Worry not. None is bothered. Happy and free. Its own reward.

coins.name: 鸭爵金币
coins.verse: 东西不错　千金不换　哈哈哈哈　再加个零
coins.enVerse: A Fine Piece! Priceless? Take my offer. Dare you refuse.

coins.name: 鸿蒙开荒
coins.verse: 百氏从炎　避祸迁徙　两江之畔　垦墟为田
coins.enVerse: We of Yan. Fled from ill. By the rivers. Farm new lands.

coins.name: 己任重
coins.verse: 平步青云　志在万里　云浮霞动　且兢其步
coins.enVerse: Rising high. Goals afar. Changing times. Measured moves.

coins.name: 圣诏封神
coins.verse: 悠悠上古　群英争辉　圣诏赫赫　一举逐神
coins.enVerse: In ages past. Heroes rose. By the edicts. Legends born.

coins.name: 神秘商贾
coins.verse: 革旧之机　从新之望　非无可买　愿以何换
coins.enVerse: Reform's hour. Hope reborn. All has its cost. What's your bid?

coins.name: 诛邪雷法
coins.verse: 其心昭明　有思则悟　诛恶及本　雷撼天地
coins.enVerse: One luminous. To know, to act. Trial by thunder. The worthy stand.

coins.name: 商路难行
coins.verse: 国之初开　荒路匪起　出金买路　镖匪同存
coins.enVerse: In nascent Yan. Roads went wild. Toss your coins. Buy a pass.

coins.name: 孜孜不倦
coins.verse: 跬步千里　聚沙成塔　稍有懈怠　再难复返
coins.enVerse: A thousand miles. Begin with one. A moment's slack. All's undone.
